summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for searchwoot.com public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream rights and any affiliate or advertising expansion; conditional for ordinary reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and data boundaries. Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private and keep permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access and rate limits, but public terms do not establish rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal data. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, vendor, retention, and owner gates remain incomplete. Technical compliance is not certification: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Analytics quality is yellow; unavailable telemetry is not treated as zero. Launch-readiness tracking is active at 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Close no task without the specified evidence and applicable gate disposition.

Data-use review decisions for searchwoot.com: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance; permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal evidence, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce the read-only log, vendor, and incident inventory. No go-live proposal is supported.

Private and gated-site decision: retain searchwoot.com at keep_private. Do not publish, expand alerts, change tracking, monetize, deploy, or send external permission outreach. A future bounded beta requires documented upstream rights, field-level data-use limits, privacy and consent evidence, security and release clearance, accuracy/freshness controls, measurement and attribution reconciliation, owner disposition, and rollback evidence.

Fleet compliance disposition: ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, cross-site behavior, unsupported claims, or monetization expansion, and preserves existing consent, cookie/analytics disclosure, affiliate disclosure, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as a standalone blocker. Compliance results are a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; the recorded open findings include banner, accept, reject, GA4, privacy, and terms checks. Site-specific failures or unknown reachability require evidence or remediation before affected launches. Revenue evidence remains partial: the available $4.92 commission is an aggregate provider row and must remain unattributed; no site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift claim is supported.

Launch-readiness progress: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Existing API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms evidence is retained but does not satisfy closure. Continue the active workstream and attach the consolidated read-only evidence bundle; do not create duplicate requests or change launch state.
